scope: User requested explanation and improvements for initial report opening and changing sections; read-only browser/source investigation, no code/runtime changes
browser: Native Chrome/CUA; read-only Performance API via DevTools in isolated report frame; normal cache settings, no cache clearing or throttling

source_findings.finding: Each create_preview generates new pv- hostname, creates context/lineage/audit, challenge/handoff steps; each preview_asset resolves live context/session/target/share, verifies identity and share policy, reserves native 3/user 12/process pool, then conditional S3 delivery.
_request constructs and closes a new httpx.Client for every identity request; no cross-request connection reuse.
authorize_share_object re-queries grant and target and writes authorization event; object_delivery adds response audit even for 304.
Deployed private proxy rule disables gzip for report assets to preserve prior S3 ETag revalidation behavior.

inferences: Measured warm Coverage navigation is dominated by waiting for multiple requests; exact individual broker/DB/S3 portions were not instrumented.
HTTP/1.1 connection queueing plus repeated protected-asset authorization/revalidation are likely contributors; browser timing alone does not isolate each server phase.
Fresh cold-open wall time was not captured; initial-path findings are source and declared bundle-size based. Browser input stopped when active-user interference was detected.
recommended_next_changes: Reuse an application-lifetime HTTPX client for Login identity calls; preserve live checks, CA validation, explicit endpoint and existing timeout.
Enable HTTP/2 on the selected report-content HTTPS vhost and application ingress; keep existing download limits.
Keep one renderer alive across sections and fetch section data on demand; load common libraries once. This involves the generated DayOA/MultiQC bundle as well as Dewey delivery.
Reduce initial payload and restore compression with validator-correct behavior; avoid undoing the working conditional-cache fix.
